source.title: Performance of Time-series Momentum Strategy: US

transposability.what_transfers: The use of MA and EMA signals and the relative ranking of strategies by Sharpe ratio can be applied to intraday futures.
what_does_not_transfer: Absolute Sharpe ratio values (e.g., 2.403) are based on daily S&P500 data and may not hold for intraday futures.
Maximum drawdown percentages are specific to the daily equity market sample.
Transaction‑cost rates examined (0, 0.001, 0.005, 0.01) may differ in magnitude and impact for futures contracts.
transposability.what_aligns_well: Lower transaction‑cost environments improve strategy performance, a pattern that likely holds for futures trading.
